For any mean-zero prescribed background w(t), put A(t)=P_E L_w(t)P_E on E, where L_w v=P[(w dot grad)v+(v dot grad)w] is the physical Euler linearisation. Every Fourier matrix contribution shifts k by a nonzero background wavevector. There is therefore no diagonal Fourier contribution and tr_E A(t)=0. The real trace equals the trace in its conjugation-compatible complex representation, so this is not an artifact of complex controls.

The CLOSED inviscid Galerkin propagator T'= -A(t)T,T(0)=I consequently has detT=1 by differentiating logdetT (or Liouville's determinant identity). take the trace after multiplying by R^-1 to get D<=(1-gamma)D, a contradiction.
